verdicts.reason: A: the reading order is jumbled. 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' sits below the date and venue, and the URL comes before the venue. Text alignment switches between left and centred. The RSVP button has been shrunk to a small blob in a row with the badges. The grey placeholder is enlarged and dominates the bottom-left corner. B: it has the same misordered eyebrow and URL. The text stack is cramped with almost no leading. The RSVP CTA has shrunk to a badge-sized pill inside the badge cluster, so it is completely buried. There is a large dead area between the phone and the footer. A keeps the CTA slightly more recognisable as a button.
